name: Nanda Bayin
role: King of the Toungoo dynasty of Burma from 1581 to 1599
contribution: He presided over the collapse of the First Toungoo Empire.
legacy: The Restored Toungoo administrative reforms, which with Konbaung modifications, would last to the end of Burmese monarchy in 1885, had their origins in the failures of this person.

checks.lead: Nanda Bayin (Burmese: နန္ဒ ဘုရင်, pronounced [nàɰ̃da̰ bəjɪ̀ɰ̃]; Thai: นันทบุเรง, RTGS: Nantha Bureng; 9 November 1535 – 30 November [O.S. 20 November] 1600) was king of the Toungoo dynasty of Burma (Myanmar) from 1581 to 1599. He presided over the collapse of the First Toungoo Empire.
